intentionalDelta.item: malformed catalogue-price handling in the authoritative costEngine
intentionalDelta.detail: a non-finite or negative formal catalogue price is no longer accepted as-is. Production produced a NEGATIVE total for a negative catalogue price and NaN for null/undefined/non-numeric; the candidate contributes 0 and reports the part in missingParts so current cost reports incomplete. A valid zero price is UNCHANGED and byte-equivalent to production.
intentionalDelta.formalBasis: parts.price is `REAL DEFAULT 0` with `CHECK(price IS NULL OR price >= 0)`; partCommands validates with parseNonNegativeNumber; partQueries uses a price filter lower bound of 0
